cues: A clock with only four hours: nought, one, two, three.
Start at two and move on three: you land on one.
Start at three, move on one: back to nought.
text: A clock with only four hours: nought, one, two, three. Start at two and move on three: you land on one. Start at three, move on one: back to nought. Arithmetic that wraps round.
